column3: MT 31:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “a house of strongholds” is rendered “A fortress of defense.”
Close to the Hebrew; מָעוּזִּי (“my refuge”) is rendered “my strength.”
Close to the Hebrew; “vanities of falsehood” is rendered “useless idols.”
Close to the Hebrew; הִסְגַּרְתַּנִי (“handed me over”) is rendered “have not shut me up.”
Close to the Hebrew; “exceedingly” is rendered “especially,” and “a dread” “repulsive.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִשְׁאוֹל (“in Sheol”) is rendered “in the grave.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a city of siege” is rendered “a strong city,” and “covenant loyalty” “marvelous kindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; עַל־ יֶתֶר (“abundantly”) is rendered “fully.”
